boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Simpson College
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe Indianola and campus destinations with currently published evening hours; confirm holiday and break changes before heading out.

cards.title: Pfeiffer Dining Hall
cards.subtitle: Simpson College campus
cards.notes: Use the published dinner window for an on-campus evening meal; check the dining page for break or special-service changes before you go.
cards.short_summary: Campus dining is scheduled through 9 p.m. daily.
cards.evidence_claim: Simpson College lists Pfeiffer Dining Hall dinner service from 5 to 9 p.m. on weekdays and weekends.
cards.access_notes: Published dinner hours are 5–9 p.m. daily; service may change during academic breaks.

cards.title: Tyler's Grille
cards.subtitle: Kent Campus Center, Simpson College
cards.notes: Plan an evening stop in Kent Campus Center on a weekday; Friday has the latest listed closing time, while weekend service is closed.
cards.short_summary: A campus grille with listed service as late as 11 p.m. Friday.
cards.evidence_claim: Simpson College lists Tyler's Grille open until 9:30 p.m. Monday–Thursday and until 11 p.m. Friday.
cards.access_notes: Published hours: Mon–Thu 11 a.m.–9:30 p.m.; Fri 11 a.m.–11 p.m.; closed Saturday and Sunday.

cards.title: SubConnection
cards.subtitle: Kent Campus Center, Simpson College
cards.notes: Use this Kent Campus Center option for a weekday evening stop; its listed hours end earlier than Tyler's Grille, so check the clock.
cards.short_summary: Weekday campus food service listed until 8:30 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Simpson College lists SubConnection open Monday through Friday until 8:30 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Published hours: Mon–Fri 8:30 a.m.–8:30 p.m.; Saturday C-Store only noon–6 p.m.; Sunday closed.

cards.title: Taco Bell on N Jefferson Way
cards.subtitle: 1303 N Jefferson Way, Indianola
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru hours when you need a clearly listed late option; dine-in closes earlier, so choose the service that matches the time.
cards.short_summary: A listed drive-thru option as late as 3 a.m. on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell's official Indianola location page lists drive-thru service until 1 a.m. most nights and 3 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell - 1303 N Jefferson Way, Indianola
cards.access_notes: Published drive-thru hours: until 1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday; dine-in hours end earlier.

cards.title: Casey's on N Jefferson Way
cards.subtitle: 607 N Jefferson Way, Indianola
cards.notes: For an evening convenience-store stop, use the official store page to check pickup or delivery availability before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: Store service is listed until 11 p.m., with pickup and delivery until 10:30 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Casey's lists its 607 N Jefferson Way Indianola store open 5 a.m. to 11 p.m. daily and pickup and delivery until 10:30 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Published daily hours: store 5 a.m.–11 p.m.; pickup and delivery 5 a.m.–10:30 p.m.

cards.title: Casey's on W 2nd Avenue
cards.subtitle: 1006 W 2nd Ave, Indianola
cards.notes: This separate Indianola Casey's has listed late store, pickup, and delivery hours; verify the service type before making the trip.
cards.short_summary: A west-side convenience option listed through 11 p.m. daily.
cards.evidence_claim: Casey's lists its 1006 W 2nd Ave Indianola store open 4 a.m. to 11 p.m. daily and pickup and delivery until 10:30 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Published daily hours: store 4 a.m.–11 p.m.; pickup and delivery 4 a.m.–10:30 p.m.

cards.title: Indianola Walmart Supercenter
cards.subtitle: 1500 N Jefferson Way, Indianola
cards.notes: Use the store for practical evening needs rather than a department-specific errand; some in-store services close before the building does.
cards.short_summary: The full store is listed open until 11 p.m. every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Walmart lists Indianola Supercenter #1491 at 1500 N Jefferson Way open 6 a.m. to 11 p.m. Monday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Published store hours are 6 a.m.–11 p.m. daily; individual departments have separate hours.

cards.title: Indianola Hy-Vee
cards.subtitle: 910 N Jefferson Way, Indianola
cards.notes: For a late grocery run, follow the published store hours and note that counters and departments may close earlier than the main store.
cards.short_summary: The main grocery store is listed open through 10:30 p.m. daily.
cards.evidence_claim: Hy-Vee lists its Indianola store at 910 N Jefferson Way open daily from 6 a.m. to 10:30 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Published main-store hours are 6 a.m.–10:30 p.m. daily; department hours vary.

cards.title: Indianola Public Library
cards.subtitle: 207 N B St, Indianola
cards.notes: Use a Monday-through-Thursday evening for reading, research, or a quiet change of scene; check the posted holiday closures before visiting.
cards.short_summary: A public library option with weekday evening hours until 8 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Indianola lists Indianola Public Library hours as 10 a.m. to 8 p.m. Monday through Thursday.
cards.access_notes: Published hours: Monday–Thursday 10 a.m.–8 p.m.; Friday–Saturday 10 a.m.–5 p.m.; Sunday closed; holiday closures apply.

cards.title: Indianola Wellness Campus
cards.subtitle: 306 E Scenic Valley Ave, Indianola
cards.notes: Schedule an early-evening workout or indoor track session Monday through Thursday, and check membership or guest access requirements in advance.
cards.short_summary: City wellness facilities are listed open until 8 p.m. Monday through Thursday.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Indianola lists the Indianola Wellness Campus open 5 a.m. to 8 p.m. Monday through Thursday.
cards.access_notes: Published hours: Mon–Thu 5 a.m.–8 p.m.; Fri 5 a.m.–7 p.m.; Sat 7 a.m.–4 p.m.; Sunday closed. Membership or guest access may be required.
